labels: AI by-eye labels (WP3 part 2), test video: scoring only
rule: as for the dev clip: event frame = first frame whose centre (960, 540) shows the other side of the surface; crossing = frames in between. Applied here: sky seen through the surface from just below (Snell's window, brown reflection of the back around it) is still the underwater side; a draining water sheet over the lens with distorted sky is crossing; entry froth (beige streaked bubbles) counts as the water side, a water sheet with sky still visible is crossing. Revised 2026-11-20 to the agreed boundary cases: Snell's window just under the surface = underwater; half-out phase (waterline rim / brown band at the centre) = crossing; after that, waves or sheets washing over the lens with sky visible = air (exit frames moved 6-11 frames earlier); entry froth = water side (bubbles).
